about.title: About Us
about.description: Bato Vetiyo is a smart bus tracking and route information platform built to make daily commuting easier, faster, and more reliable. With real-time bus tracking, intelligent route planning, and instant alerts, we bring simplicity and convenience to public transportation.
about.team_description: We are a passionate team of innovators and engineers dedicated to transforming the way people travel in cities. Our mission is to make public transportation more transparent, reliable, and accessible for everyone.

help.title: Help & Support
help.faq1_question: How can I find nearby bus stops?
help.faq1_answer: You can use the map or route planner to view all nearby bus stops from your current location.
help.faq2_answer: Some features like saved routes and reminders work offline, but live bus tracking requires an internet connection.
help.faq3_question: How do I change the language?
help.faq3_answer: Go to Settings > Language and choose English or Nepali.
help.faq4_question: Is the app free to use?
help.faq4_answer: Yes, batoVetiyo is completely free to use with no hidden charges.
help.contact_support: If your question is not listed above, feel free to contact our support team for assistance.

services.route_planning_desc: Plan your journey efficiently with real-time suggested bus routes from your current location to your destination.
services.real_time_tracking_desc: Track buses live on the map so you know exactly when your bus will arrive.

services.offline_access_desc: Access saved routes and reminders even without an internet connection.
